literal_meaning: গড়া (to shape or form) + পেটা (to beat or slap)
figurative_meaning_en: Altering the outcome of a sports event or game through dishonest or unfair means
example_sentences_in_bangla: ফুটবল টুর্নামেন্টে গড়াপেটা করে দলটি অপ্রত্যাশিতভাবে জিতে গেল।
ক্রিকেট ম্যাচে গড়াপেটার অভিযোগ উঠেছে, তাই তদন্ত শুরু হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The team unexpectedly won the football tournament through garapeta.
There are allegations of garapeta in the cricket match, so an investigation has begun.
note: This idiom is commonly used in the context of sports rigging in Bengali-speaking regions, synonymous with 'সেটিং' borrowed from English.
